parent_objective: persistent or later wrong-history intervention design

public_gates: design a persistent wrong-history intervention that keeps the wrong hidden belief active for K emergency steps
design a later-injection intervention at or after obstacle reveal
define pass/fail criteria against M475 reset/zero-current and wrong-history baselines
preserve P0 actor contract and no-privileged inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add privileged actor inputs
do not count artificial persistent intervention as deployable behavior proof without labeling it diagnostic
do not relax near-boundary normal-margin requirements
hypothesis: A one-shot wrong-history injection is corrected too quickly; persistent or later wrong-history intervention will distinguish whether recurrent belief can be outcome-critical when the wrong belief is active during the emergency decision window.
success_criteria: document the exact intervention variants to implement
define how persistent wrong hidden state is applied without changing actor inputs
define diagnostic pass criteria for action distance, trajectory distance, margin gap, success drop, and source diversity
pre-register implementation artifacts for the next milestone
failure_criteria: design confuses diagnostic intervention with deployable actor input
design proposes training before intervention evidence
design counts reset/zero-current degradation as wrong-history proof

commands.name: persistent_wrong_history_intervention_design
commands.command: Use M476 audit artifacts to design persistent/later wrong-history intervention variants; no training.

decision_rule: M477 can admit implementation only if it keeps the intervention diagnostic, preserves actor contract, and explicitly tests whether wrong belief persistence is the missing causal factor.
next_blocker: pending M477 persistent wrong-history intervention design
